ios.desc:
Orca (formerly Happyfeed) is a gratitude journal that focuses on beautiful photos, short videos, and sharing options. Record positive moments every day to improve your mood and remind yourself of all the good. Plus, you'll be creating an record of all your best memories. Keep it private or use groups like a micro social network by sharing select memories with friends and family.
 • Add multiple photos, video & location
 • Widgets: Daily throwbacks and shared memories
 • Group sharing for couples, friends & family
 • Unique prompts, quotes, and fun facts every day
 • Gratitude Jar to view random past posts
 • All posts are 100% private by default
 • Tag your best days with an emoji
 • Unlimited days you can post for free
 • Passcode & lock screen with Face ID
 • PDF/CSV Export for printing (Plus only)

Explore Your Past Memories - After one week, you can view memories in your gratitude journal from a week ago. This period grows to months and even years. You can also see random moments using the Gratitude Jar. Each month, create a recap video of your favorite photos and clips.

Journaling Together - Pods are private groups for sharing memories and send emoji reactions. Send only selected photos, videos, and text to your friends, partner, or family. It's perfect for long distance relationships and faraway family.

Unique Reminders Each Day - Every day we write a custom prompt to help you remember to record your feelings. It could be a quote about happiness, a fact about the day, or a joke to brighten your day and put you in a happy mood.

Benefits of Gratitude Journaling - Gratitude journaling is a simple and easy self-care practice that helps reduce stress and anxiety while improving your overall happiness. In even a few seconds, the practice of actively reflecting on 3 good things or what you are grateful for can help you refocus on the positives in life.

Private Diary On All Your Devices - We also offer a web version where you can upload and view your past moments. Your moments and photos are privately synced to your account so you’ll never lose them. Plus Subscribers can download their journal in PDF or CSV format.

Secret & Secure Self-Love - Your moments are only visible to you and never posted publicly. All cloud syncing is securely encrypted using HTTPS endpoints. You can create a passcode lock for extra security (Face ID supported).
